name: Blades
description: Knives, swords, and anything you can stab with that wasn't designed for salad.

perks.text: Crit range with blades expands by 1.

name: Blunt Weapons
description: Hammers, clubs, maces. The honest way to solve problems.

name: Polearms
description: Long sticks with bad intentions on the end.

perks.text: Polearms can hit enemies at near range.

name: Bows
description: Pointy sticks, delivered at a respectful distance.

perks.text: Crit range with bows expands by 1.

name: Thrown Weapons
description: Darts, knives, bricks, and the occasional sandwich.

name: Unarmed Combat
description: Fists, elbows, knees, and teeth if it comes to that.

name: Improvised Weapons
description: Plungers, kettlebells, a microwave you found. If it's in your hand, it's a weapon.

perks.text: Improvised weapon crits deal triple dice.

name: Light Armor
description: Leather, padding, and hope.

name: Heavy Armor
description: Wearing a car door and calling it fashion.

name: Shields
description: Holding a big thing between you and the bad thing.

name: Dodge
description: The ancient art of not being where the axe is.

name: Stealth
description: Being quiet. Being small. Being somewhere else.

perks.text: First attack from stealth always crits.

name: Perception
description: Noticing the trap before the trap notices you.

perks.text: Always see trap rooms on the map once adjacent.

name: Lockpicking
description: Opening things that other people closed for a reason.

name: Trap Engineering
description: Understanding, disarming, and occasionally building nasty little machines.

name: First Aid
description: Bandages, pressure, and saying 'you'll be fine' convincingly.

name: Cooking
description: Turning dungeon meat into dungeon cuisine.

name: Explosives Handling
description: Throwing things that go boom, ideally away from your face.

perks.text: Explosives never fumble on a natural 1.

name: Athletics
description: Climbing, swimming, shoving doors, carrying a dead friend.

name: Appraisal
description: Knowing what something is and roughly what it's worth to a desperate person.

name: Spellcasting
description: General talent for reading tomes without your eyes melting.

name: Persuasion
description: Getting people to do things with words instead of hammers.

name: Intimidation
description: Getting people to do things with words that imply hammers.

name: Deception
description: Lying. Just lying. Very well.

name: Bartering
description: Paying less than the sticker price in a store run by a demon.

name: Tinkering
description: Making useful things out of useless things. Rank adds to crafting checks at a workbench.
